goal: Make the Windows bitcoin wrapper wait for child processes instead of exiting immediately with code zero
Allow callers, scripts, and test suites on Windows to inspect child exit codes and capture output
reviewability: Nothing known that would invalidate a review now
agreement: Concept approval without stated reasons (hebasto, hodlinator)
Objection on missing file error formatting on MSVCRT was withdrawn after MSVCRT removal (cyb3ralbert)

categories.name: ipc
why: P2 because it ensures multiprocess binaries on Windows track and wait for child process execution
Re-enables functional test suites on Windows that were previously skipped due to uncaptured output

categories.name: tools
why: P2 because callers and test harnesses can now detect tool failures and capture stdout/stderr on Windows
Resolves a defect where the Windows wrapper reported success regardless of child process outcome
